**James Fitz Edmond Cotter**

James Fitz Edmond Cotter was an Irish politician who served as a member of the Irish Parliament in the late 18th century. **Early Life and Career**

Cotter was born in County Cork, Ireland, in 1750. He came from a prominent family of landowners and was educated at Trinity College in Dublin. After completing his studies, he entered politics and was elected as a member of the Irish Parliament in 1776, representing the constituency of Castlemartyr. **Marriage to Eleanora Plunkett**

Cotter married Eleanora Plunkett, a member of the Irish peerage, in 1778. Eleanora was the daughter of Randall Plunkett, 1st Baron of Dunsany, and his wife, Margaret Archbold. The marriage was a significant one, as it united two prominent families in Irish society. **Sources**
